acl.tool_rule_compatibility: all ALLOW principals equal the owner, DACL non-empty; matches D2Production.protect()

key_bytes.baseline_compared: hash captured before any ACL change; identical after repair

incident.summary: 第一次 ACL 修正把四个文件的 DACL 清空，且该卷拒绝重新写入 DACL；随后以逐字节一致的副本完成恢复。
sequence: setowner + grant daily user + remove Administrators + strip inheritance applied to directory and files
the (OI)(CI) grant did not land as a usable file ACE, and /inheritance:r /T removed the inherited ACEs
all four files ended with a protected empty DACL (SDDL D:PAI, owner = daily user)
subsequent DACL writes were rejected with Win32 error 5 by icacls, SetNamedSecurityInfo, SetFileSecurity, SetSecurityInfo on a handle, and takeown, with SeTakeOwnership/SeRestore/SeBackup enabled
PowerShell-side reads were denied; a control test on C: with the same owner/empty-DACL recovered normally, so the rejection is specific to this volume
recovery: copied the four files to a staging directory with the same bytes and verified SHA-256 equality
set the staging files to owner = daily user with a single Allow ACE
renamed the four original files to *.locked
moved the verified staging copies into place
re-verified hashes, ACL, owner and key pair match, then removed the *.locked copies and the staging directory
incident.notes: No key material was printed, transmitted or committed at any point.

tool_verification.interpretation: identity() passed (external path, ACL, key.json scope/test_identity, key_id format, RSA-3072 strength, file readability); the run then stopped at the registry read because gh is not installed. No output directory was created and no upload was attempted.

non_elevated_session.reason: The agent session always runs elevated; privilege-dropping launchers (runas, scheduled tasks) are blocked by the local security policy. No non-elevated shell could be started from this session.
non_elevated_session.deterministic_basis: The DACL now grants only the daily user FullControl with no deny entries, so a standard token of that user is granted access by ACL evaluation. The remaining confirmation is a one-command read test in a normal PowerShell window.

recommended.credential_separation: Replace the agent's stored GitHub credential with a fine-grained PAT limited to this repository: Contents read/write, Pull requests read/write, Metadata read; no Administration and no Workflows. Without this, the agent can edit CODEOWNERS or disable the ruleset, so no GitHub-side rule is enforceable.
recommended.codeowners: Add .github/CODEOWNERS with '/.github/CODEOWNERS @shimao1115' and '/config/pack-publishers.json @shimao1115' so the file that enforces the gate is itself gated.
recommended.ruleset: Branch ruleset on main: require a pull request before merging, require review from code owners, block force pushes, restrict deletions, empty bypass list.
recommended.effect: Knowledge packs keep going to candidate branches with no added review. Routine main changes can be merged by the agent through a PR. Any change to the publisher registry requires an approval from the repository owner that the agent cannot give to itself.
